title: Tweening (animated transitions)
summary: Smooth change over time without per-frame code: TweenService interpolates properties (position, size, color, transparency…) using TweenInfo recipes. Create → Play → (optionally) await Completed.

explanation.whatItIs: Declarative animation: say WHERE you want to end up and HOW it should feel; the engine drives every frame in between.
explanation.whyItExists: Hand-rolling lerps in Heartbeat is boilerplate-prone; tweens package interpolation + easing + events.
whenToUse: UI motion: panels sliding in, bars filling, fading overlays
World motion: doors sliding, platforms moving, camera moves
whenNotToUse: Physics-driven movement — tweens fight the simulator
Per-frame interactive motion (camera follow) — use RenderStepped/Lerp
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
goal = { Position = target, Transparency = 0 }
recipe = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Quad, Out)
tween = TweenService:Create(object, recipe, goal)
tween:Play()
tween.Completed:Wait()   -- optional: sequence next steps
```
tips: Reuse Tween objects when repeating the same transition — just Play again
Cancel before starting a competing tween on the same properties
Completed fires with PlaybackState (Completed/Cancelled) — check it when chaining
commonMistakes: Tweening properties the object doesn't have (silent no-op… or error for typos on classes)
Anchored=false parts drifting under physics while tweened
GUI tweens racing player input — guard against double-triggers

examples.title: Menu slide-in
examples.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local panel = script.Parent.ShopPanel   -- anchored off-screen left

local hidden = UDim2.new(-0.4, 0, 0.5, 0)
local shown  = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
local info = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

panel.Position = hidden
local slideIn  = TweenService:Create(panel, info, { Position = shown })
local slideOut = TweenService:Create(panel, info, { Position = hidden })

local open = false
script.Parent.ToggleButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    open = not open
    if open then slideIn:Play() else slideOut:Play() end
end)
